claim_ceiling: Campaign design only. No dataset has been downloaded, no SHA-256 artifact digest has been calculated, no model inference or DFT run has been performed, and no published result has been reproduced by this plan.

required_pins_before_execution: exact 2026 benchmark candidate and DFT-reference structure IDs/manifests, or a clearly labelled independently assembled reproduction set
SHA-256 and byte length for every consumed dataset, structure archive, model checkpoint, evaluator, code revision and configuration
model license/terms and supported-element/interface compatibility checks
reference electronic-structure settings and convergence tests
canonical structure identity and deduplication rules fixed before test results are evaluated
grouped split by parent system and declared surface/size/temperature stratum; audit potential training-data overlap where feasible
all GA details beyond population and generations, including RNG seeds and mutation/cut-and-splice settings, transcribed from the source
cost ledger that includes failed relaxations, reference calculations, model inference, preprocessing, retries and post-processing
resolve the exact 2026 benchmark candidate/test/reference structure manifest and supplement; the related Zenodo source archive is not assumed to be the independent evaluation set
for each baseline checkpoint, audit training-data/structure overlap; report archive-overlap diagnostics, published-reference reproduction, and held-out evaluation as separate result classes
materialize all four related source archives only when needed; recompute SHA-256 and exact byte length locally while preserving source-record MD5 in a separate field
metrics: MAE/RMSE/max error for binding energy on identical structures with common reference labels
DFT-refined best binding energy per stratum and difference from the best known reference structure
unique reference-validated low-energy structures recovered under equal DFT-reference budget
recovery of published/reference DFT-refined best-known minima using a frozen structure matching/deduplication tolerance; do not call true global optimum unless independently established
structural diversity, duplicate-minimum rate, and candidate-set Jaccard
ranking agreement only on shared canonical structure IDs, with discovery-set agreement reported separately
failure-mode counts/rates by stratum and severity, with abstentions separate and failed relaxations retained in denominators
total cost and cost per unique reference-validated discovery
all fixed-seed campaign records including failed, incomplete and target-not-reached campaigns
held-out discovery metrics only on groups with audited model-training overlap; archive-overlap diagnostics and published-reference reproduction are separate result classes
gates: First reproduce the published protocol/results within a declared tolerance before claiming any advantage.
Compare all search policies at equal reference-calculation budget and report total costs, not only model-inference time.
Keep per-structure energy accuracy separate from structural-discovery quality.
Do not pool results across particle sizes or support surfaces before reporting each stratum.
No SOTA claim without exact task, data, checkpoint, evaluator, split, configuration and metric parity with the comparison target.

Policy comparison stretch target: at least 20 paired fixed-seed campaigns, median acceleration factor >=2 with a 95% bootstrap lower bound >1 only if both methods reach the same frozen objective target and quality at equal cost is no worse. This is a proposed target, not a result.
A simulation or MLIP output is never a measurement; physical claims require independent metrology and reproducible procedures.

Compute the median paired AF and a deterministic percentile-bootstrap interval with a pinned PRNG seed and at least 1,000 resamples; every predeclared pair must reach the same frozen target, and failed/incomplete campaigns stay visible rather than being success-filtered.
never report a structure present in a baseline model's training data as held-out model performance; label it as a training-data diagnostic or published-reference reproduction instead
Report paired target-attainment over all predeclared seeds, including failed/incomplete runs as not reaching target, separately from the conditional cost-to-target acceleration interval.

published_candidate_refinement.pool_note: Implied by the 50-member population and 20-generation GA protocol only if every generation's complete population is counted as candidate evaluations; exact implementation/evaluation count must be extracted from GDPy source/paper supplement before assuming this count.
published_candidate_refinement.selection_rule: select the 50 lowest-MLIP-energy candidate structures from each of the three MLIP searches and locally optimize each selected structure using the pinned DFT reference method
published_candidate_refinement.duplicates_and_failures: must preserve original candidate rows, count failed relaxations and duplicate minima; report the paper-compatible metric and a second deduplicated unique-discovery metric
published_candidate_refinement.global_minimum_claim_ceiling: Finite stochastic GA search cannot establish the true global minimum. Label reference results as best-known or published DFT-refined minima unless an independent proof/exhaustive enumeration supports a global-optimum claim.

policy_comparison.budget_note: Use a 150-reference-relaxation-per-stratum budget only if it is appropriate to the exact matched decision-layer experiment; otherwise preregister a different common budget before seeing test outcomes. Do not assume it is directly comparable to the paper's three-model combined refinement set.

published_result_fingerprint.interpretation: Historical paper-reported finite-search counts for the 12 size×surface cases. Treat as a reproduction fingerprint, not as a guaranteed result under a different random seed; deviations require traceable seed/protocol analysis and must not be silently fitted.

published_ranking_settings.rbo_variant: finite-list extrapolated RBO: (1-p) sum over depth d of p^(d-1) times prefix agreement A_d, plus p^k times A_k
published_ranking_settings.common_candidate_set: same canonical structure IDs for each model prediction and the DFT-refined reference; compute structural-discovery set overlap separately
